sourceRefs.note: Institutional or curatorial reference for movement context.

sourceRefs.quote: Conceptual art is art for which the idea (or concept) behind the work is more important than the finished art object.
sourceRefs.note: [DEFINITION_OR_IDENTITY] El arte conceptual es un tipo de arte para el cual la idea o concepto detrás de la obra es más importante que el objeto artístico final.

sourceRefs.quote: The term conceptual art was first used to reference this distinct movement in an article written by Sol LeWitt in 1967: In conceptual art the idea or concept is the most important aspect of the work.
sourceRefs.note: [CHRONOLOGY] El término arte conceptual fue utilizado por primera vez en 1967 en un artículo escrito por Sol LeWitt para referirse a este movimiento distinto.

sourceRefs.quote: When an artist uses a conceptual form of art, it means that all of the planning and decisions are made beforehand and the execution is a perfunctory affair.
sourceRefs.note: [PRACTICE_OR_METHOD] El arte conceptual implica que toda la planificación y las decisiones se realizan antes de la ejecución, que es una cuestión rutinaria.

sourceRefs.quote: This is because, unlike a painter or sculptor who will think about how best they can express their idea using paint or sculptural materials and techniques, a conceptual artist uses whatever materials and whatever form is most appropriate to putting their idea across – this could be anything from a performance to a written description.
sourceRefs.note: [PRACTICE_OR_METHOD] El arte conceptual utiliza cualquier material y forma apropiada para transmitir una idea, lo que puede variar desde un performance hasta una descripción escrita.
